name: com.rushhourplanner/rush-hour-planner
title: Rush Hour Planner
description: Drive-time forecast: when to leave, the best departure time, commute traffic, or drive time by hour.

tools.name: rushhour_departure_forecast
tools.description: Use this when the user asks when to leave for a drive, the best departure time, drive time, commute traffic, or rush hour between two places. Returns hourly drive times and the shortest departure, in one call, for a road route in the United States, the United Kingdom, or Canada. Omit date for the next 24 hours from now, in local time at the starting point. Departures later today and tomorrow inside that window are labelled Today or Tomorrow, or Now (this hour) when that hour is already underway (window_start, window_end, coverage). Optional date is YYYY-MM-DD in local time at the starting point, for today, tomorrow, or a chosen day up to 7 days ahead, the same days the website offers. Convert a phrase such as next Wednesday to that date. tomorrow, a weekday, and next-wednesday are also accepted. A past day or a day past that limit returns an error naming the supported range. A fresh forecast for the next 24 hours was generated in the current hour and is at most 45 minutes old (generatedAt, ageMinutes, freshness, age_seconds). A chosen day uses the same stored forecast as the website. Quote freshness. When a live lookup is busy, rate-limited, or refused and a curve from the last 48 hours is stored, the result includes stale true, stale_message, and retry_after, with departures that have already passed removed. Do not use for turn-by-turn directions, transit, walking, live incident reports, places outside the United States, the United Kingdom, and Canada, or a past day.

origin.description: City or address where the drive starts, in the United States, the United Kingdom, or Canada. Example: Manchester, or Toronto, ON.

destination.description: City or address where the drive ends, in the United States, the United Kingdom, or Canada. Example: Heathrow Airport, or Ottawa, ON.

date.description: Optional day to forecast, as YYYY-MM-DD in local time at the starting point. Omit for the next 24 hours from now. Today, tomorrow, or a day up to 7 days ahead, the same days the website offers. tomorrow, a weekday, and next-wednesday are accepted. Convert a phrase such as next Wednesday to a date. A past day or a later day returns an error naming the supported range.

response_format.description: concise returns the best departure, duration, and when the forecast was made. detailed also returns each hour's drive time. Omit for concise.
